The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 6. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 1 year before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 7. Generic

Generic Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Consignee only. 9. Generic While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 10. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 11. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 12. Rate Contract Performance Security: Against all Purchase Orders placed by any buyer against the Rate Contract Catalogue, the seller would be required to furnish a performance security of 3 % of total contract value of the relevant Purchase Order as per GeM GTC. 13. Rate Contract The Purchase orders placed through the rate of this bid shall be placed by . The order shall be placed by buyer separately based on the requirement. 14. Rate Contract Tax and Duties Toll Tax/ Entry Tax/ Octroi Duty & Local Taxes. No separate payment would be made by the Buyer for Toll Taxes, Entry Taxes, Octroi duty and local Taxes, if any. The Seller should cater for these Taxes/ duties as part of Basic Rate quoted in the Bid. 15. Rate Contract Packing Material The items will be supplied by the successful bidder in its original packing material and the packing material will not be returned. Weight of packing material will not be included in quantity supplied and only net weight of the items will be counted. The packing should be of standardized weights of appropriate size. Item will not be accepted in non-standardized weights.Packing Material. 17. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses RATE CONTRACT FOR SUPPLY OF NUTRITIOUS FOOD FOR DOGS 1. Bid Submission: Bids shall be submitted online through GeM. Bidders shall upload a duly filled technical compliance statement mentioning brand, make, model/variant, manufacturer/OEM, pack size, nutritional c omposition, country of origin and relevant product literature. Acceptance of all tender conditions shall be mandatory. 2. Eligibility and Documents: The bidder shall be a legally registered firm/company/proprietorship/partners hip with valid GST registration, PAN, firm registration certificate, bank details, address proof and Udyam c ertificate, wherever applicable. Non-manufacturers shall submit valid OEM authorization/dealership/distrib utorship certificates. Previous supply orders and satisfactory completion/acceptance certificates for dog fo od, pet food, animal feed or similar products during the last 3/5 years, as specified in the GeM Bid, shall b e furnished. 3. Turnover and Experience: The bidder shall fulfil the minimum average annual turnover requirement for FY 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26, as specified in the GeM Bid, supported by a CA-certified certificate. 4. Scope and Delivery Schedule: The successful bidder shall supply the specified quantity of dog food at t he consignee location through doorstep delivery. Delivery shall be made on a staggered basis as per the r equirements and consumption pattern of the concerned User Agency. Perishable items, including milk, me at and other similar items, shall be delivered three times a week, while the remaining items shall ordinaril y be delivered once a month or as and when instructed by the concerned User Agency, depending upon a ctual requirements and storage facilities. The Buyer/User Agency reserves the right to modify the delivery schedule and quantities as per operational requirements. The Seller shall ensure timely and uninterrupted supply as instructed. All expenses relating to packing, transportation, loading, unloading and doorstep deli very shall be borne by the Seller.. 5. Product Quality: Supplies shall strictly conform to the prescribed nutritional and technical specifications . Products must be genuine, brand new, unused, uncontaminated and in original manufacturer-sealed pac kaging. No change in brand, manufacturer, variant or pack size shall be permitted without prior written ap proval. 6. Shelf Life and Packaging: Products shall have at least 75% remaining shelf life at delivery. Manufacturin g, batch and expiry/best-before details must be clearly legible. Packaging shall protect products against moisture, contamination and damage. 7. Inspection and Replacement: The Buyer/Consignee may inspect and reject wholly or partly any defectiv e, damaged, expired, contaminated or non-conforming supplies. Rejected goods shall be replaced free of cost within the stipulated period, including all transportation expenses. 8. Statutory Compliance: The Seller shall comply with applicable Government laws, standards, labelling an d procurement provisions, including country-of-origin restrictions. Counterfeit, duplicate or prohibited-origi n products shall not be accepted. 9. EMD and Performance Security: EMD exemption and Performance Security/PBG shall be governed by a pplicable GeM provisions and bid requirements. 10. Payment and Penalties: Payment shall be released after satisfactory delivery, inspection, acceptance and submission of invoice and CRAC. No advance payment shall be made unless permitted. Delays shall a ttract applicable liquidated damages under GeM conditions. 11. Declarations and Verification: The bidder shall submit a non-blacklisting declaration and certify produc t authenticity and quality. The Buyer may verify all submitted documents and cancel the contract for false declarations or fraudulent practices. 12. Bid Evaluation and Rejection: Only technically compliant bidders shall qualify for financial evaluation. Conditional bids, incomplete documents, false information, collusion or non-compliance may result in reje ction. 13. General Conditions: Bid modification/withdrawal, final acceptance, dispute-related matters and contra ct cancellation shall be governed by applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions. In case of conflict, ma ndatory GeM and Government procurement provisions shall prevail.

14. Information: A separate Scope of Work document has been uploaded along with the Additio nal Terms & Conditions (ATC).
